<h3 style="text-align: center;">What is this Website For?</h3>
<p style="text-align: left;">
Mathematics is a challenging but rewarding subject. This website exists to share my ongoing research and popular maths essays, and to provide quality mathematical services.
</p>

<h3 style="text-align: center;">Services</h3>
<p style="text-align: left;">
I offer the following services:</p>
<ul style="text-align: left;">
  <li><strong>Mathematics Tutoring & Resources:</strong> Tailored instruction and educational material creation from school up to university level.</li>
  <li><strong>Academic Mentoring:</strong> Dedicated support, guidance, and study strategies for mathematics students.</li>
  <li><strong>Data Consulting & Coding:</strong> Expert statistical analysis, data-driven modeling, and programming support (Python, LaTeX).</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: left;">
If you are interested, please get in touch so we can discuss whether I am a good fit for your needs.
</p>

<h3 style="text-align: center;">Research and Essays</h3>
<p style="text-align: left;">
My primary research interest is in heavy-tailed and power-law distributions, particularly regarding wealth distribution. I completed my PhD thesis on mathematical models and empirical analysis of wealth distribution, and I have a published paper as well as several pre-prints on macro topics including taxation, population dynamics, and stock returns.
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">
I also write popular maths essays to show how mathematics can be both interesting and useful. The difficulty and mathematical complexity of these essays will vary.
</p>

<h3 style="text-align: center;">Tutoring & Resources</h3>
<p style="text-align: left;">
I share free resources here, and my current project focuses on creating GCSE Foundation maths worksheets. **Requests for tailored worksheets are welcome—just get in touch.**
</p>

<h3 style="text-align: center;">AI Disclosure</h3>
<p style="text-align: left;">
Some purists argue against using AI entirely. While I understand that perspective, I find it a valuable tool to accelerate workflows, catch errors, and refine my writing. Today, I use AI to assist with aspects of most of my work.
</p>
